'''Chishi Uprising (赤石暴动)''' was an organised [[prison escape]] committed by [[CCP]] [[prisoners of war]] interned by [[KMT]] forces around {{#property:location (label)}} in 1942.

== Context ==

As the Japanese forces advanced towards Shangrao, KMT forces were forced to transfer their prisoners of war interned at the Shangrao concentration camps towards Fujian province. Prisoners detained at one of the sites, consisting mostly of army officers of [[CCP]] forces, decided to seize the opportunity and run for freedom.

Several conditions favoured the success of the prisoners' espace attempt:

* As motorised transport was a luxury in China at the time, the cross-province transfer was performed on foot.
* In the context of the [[United Chinese front against Japanese aggression]], which paused hostilities between [[KMT]] and [[CCP]] forces in name, the prisoners were interned under the ruse of "wartime youuth formation", and were subsequently not chained.
* During the transfer, different units of the camps were dispersed, so prisoners sometimes significantly outnumbered guards.
* The prisoners were relatively organised through sophisticated secret structures, and an escape plan has been discussed for months

== Fallout ==

The {{#property:point in time}}, while crossing the Congxi river, due to an insufficient number of boats, the prisoners were made to cross in small batches. When it reached the turn of the 6th squadron, it was already sundown, and previous squadrons have all advanced away from the river area in an attempt to reach campsite earlier. The dozen of soldiers escorting the 6th squadron somehow decided to cross the river behind the prisoners together, presumably to prevent dividing their forces even thinner and risking being further outnumbered by the prisoners. Without any one guarding the other bank of the river, the prisoners simply dispersed and made a run for it. The escorting soldiers fired into the prisoners, causing {{#property:number of deaths}} deaths. Infamilar with local terrain, some other prisoners were lost in the darkness during the run. In the end, about 70 prisoners were able to escape and regroup themselves in total.
